sources.title: Unseen Bangladesh
sources.note: District maps and downloads. The current site also covers guides, trivia and other travel features. Product claims do not establish adoption.

sources.title: The Daily Star · The viral map
sources.note: Reports Facebook distribution and interviews the creator. Traffic and hosting statements are reported claims, not audited analytics.

sources.title: The Bangladesh Today · 1990s nostalgia
sources.note: Reports local participation in a nostalgia photo format. It does not measure the size or duration of the trend.

sources.title: DataReportal · Digital 2026: Bangladesh
sources.note: 82.8 million internet users, 47.0% penetration and 64.0 million social media identities. Facebook ad reach is not a count of unique active people.

sources.title: Google Trends · Bangladesh, past 24 hours
sources.note: Earlier draft: first 25 of 88 rows at about 13:22 BDT. A later public-web check on 9 Oct matched the six selected buckets and showed 89 rows. This changing snapshot is not a national ranking.

sources.title: Google Trends · Twelve-month comparison
sources.note: Bangladesh, past 12 months, Web Search, all categories, five English search terms. We verified all 53 displayed weekly rows and the displayed averages in Chrome on 9 Oct 2026. The final week is incomplete. The chart did not load in the in-app browser.

sources.title: Google · Trends data methodology
sources.note: Explore uses a sampled, normalized index from 0 to 100. Low-volume terms can show zero. Search interest is not polling data.

sources.title: Google · Trending Now methodology
sources.note: Trending Now shows news-related surges. Traffic is bucketed and growth compares with a predicted baseline. Queries can form clusters.

sources.title: The Daily Star · Household cost pressure
sources.note: Reports higher commute and grocery costs after a fuel-price change. Interview examples do not form a representative survey.

sources.title: Bangladesh Bank · Inflation Dynamics
sources.note: Year-on-year headline inflation averaged about 9.21%. The report identifies pressure from food and energy. This is historical context, not today’s item prices.

sources.title: The Business Standard · Job applications
sources.note: Reports 21.23 lakh applications for 1,485 DSS posts. Applications closed in June. This is not an open vacancy notice.

sources.title: BSS · DSCC Clean Care
sources.note: DSCC reports 1,461 complaints and 1,020 resolutions. The figures come from an institutional release, not an independent service audit.

sources.title: Financial Express · Bosila canal initiative
sources.note: Announces a Footsteps cleanup for 10–14 October. As of this report, the event is a plan. Expected volunteers are not completed impact.

sources.title: BD Clean · About
sources.note: Describes an existing volunteer network and local cleanup activity. A potential partner, not an empty market.

sources.title: BazarBoard · Google Play
sources.note: Advertises community price submissions and history. This review did not audit price accuracy or adoption.

sources.title: TBS Graduates · nearU founder interview
sources.note: Profiles an existing events and experiences service. The founders’ audience and impact claims are not audited. The product homepage did not load during this check.

sources.title: Deshi Buli · Google Play
sources.note: Already advertises regional words, audio, quizzes and contributions. Features are listing claims.

sources.title: The Daily Star · Baishakhi games festival
sources.note: A reported example of participation in traditional games. It supports an experiment, not a national demand estimate.

sources.title: স্মৃতির স্বাদ · Food and memory
sources.note: Lustre Dwip, with EMK Centre support, documents Chakma food and personal memories in phase one. A private family record is a different task. Adoption was not measured.

sources.title: Next.js · Server and Client Components
sources.note: Supports server-rendered public pages and focused browser interactions. Framework features do not guarantee SEO results.

sources.title: Next.js · Metadata and OG images
sources.note: Built-in metadata and Open Graph image conventions support search and link previews.

sources.title: BSS · Revised bus fares
sources.note: Reports fare changes and category-specific rules. The actual route fare schedules and gazette still need verification before a fare tool can launch.

sources.title: The Business Standard · Train-ticket friction
sources.note: Passenger interviews describe digital access and booking difficulties. This is specific reported experience, not a full usability audit.

sources.title: Ekhon TV · Tel Koi
sources.note: Reports a crowdsourced fuel tool. Conflicting station totals were excluded. A live fuel directory already has a local precedent.

sources.title: Meta · How we combat scraping
sources.note: Explains that automated collection requires permission. It is not a grant of access to Facebook data.

sources.title: BrainKhela
sources.note: Already advertises free Bangla quizzes and games without signup. A broad quiz collection faces existing supply.

sources.title: Kombeshi · Bangla food and cost tools
sources.note: Advertises meal cost, weekly plans, price comparison and TCB indexes. This research did not audit accuracy or adoption.

sources.title: Department of Agricultural Marketing · Market prices
sources.note: An existing source for market price reports. Availability, reuse rights, update frequency and integration still need a check before product use.

sources.title: Jaatra · Dhaka bus journeys
sources.note: Already advertises routes, transfers and fares. Its FAQ describes simulated vehicle positions until operator GPS becomes available. This research did not audit route accuracy.

sources.title: Prothom Alo · Notun Kuri memories
sources.note: Reports old photos and memories on Facebook after an announcement that Notun Kuri will return. An event-specific observation, not a national nostalgia survey.

sources.title: ICPSR · Meta Content Library
sources.note: Public social content research has controlled access and researcher eligibility. This session has no Meta Content Library access.

sources.title: Google · Trends API
sources.note: The official API is an alpha with limited access. Its consistently scaled data differs from the Explore index. This session has no API access.

sources.title: The Daily Star · Student flood coordination
sources.note: A historical example of students using a website to coordinate relief requests. Current operation was not verified. Emergency response needs verification and accountable operators.

sources.title: Dhaka Tribune · Affordable food videos
sources.note: Editorial observations of cheap meal and portion-focused videos. No national prevalence measure. Mentioned prices are not current verified offers.

sources.title: Old Board Questions
sources.note: A free SSC/HSC past-paper website. This research did not audit paper accuracy, permissions or adoption. It shows existing educational supply.

sources.title: Next.js · Static exports
sources.note: A browser-only Next.js product can use a static export. Server features require a compatible server deployment.

sources.title: Meta · Public-interest research tools
sources.note: Describes application access for qualified academic and nonprofit research. CrowdTangle retired on 14 Aug 2024. This project has no restricted research access.

sources.title: Google · Search terms and Topics
sources.note: Terms do not automatically cover all synonyms or spellings. Topics can include the same concept across languages. Five English terms do not measure national interest in five subjects.

ideas.name: My childhood postcard
ideas.problem: Help a person express a familiar memory in a form that friends can answer.
ideas.mvp: Choose games, everyday moments and objects. Add an optional name. Download one Bangla postcard. Keep all inputs in the browser.
ideas.share: The card asks: “তোমার ছোটবেলা কেমন ছিল?” A friend can make a different card from the same link.
ideas.difference: A personal memory collage. No travel score, identity test or “real Bangladeshi” rank.
ideas.evidence: Nostalgia reports in August 2025 and September 2026, plus October map-sharing reports, support a timely experiment. They do not prove demand.
ideas.competitor: Unseen Bangladesh and generic nostalgia-card tools are adjacent. No dedicated local equivalent surfaced in this bounded search. That does not prove novelty.
ideas.test: Let 20 adults try it without instructions. Then observe at least 100 qualified starts. Look for completion and voluntary sharing.
ideas.risk: A one-use novelty can fade fast. Represent different places and generations. Use original art. Names and memories stay private until the user exports them.
ideas.next: If people want a useful second action, add a small traditional-play invitation. Do not add a social feed.

ideas.name: A household basket, made clear
ideas.problem: A household or student needs a clear list and a total before the next bazaar trip.
ideas.mvp: Enter item, amount, unit and price. See the basket total and budget difference. Export a list. Save locally with a clear delete control.
ideas.share: Send the actual shopping list to a household member. Keep budget and totals optional on the export.
ideas.difference: Turn the user’s own prices into a useful basket. BazarBoard already targets community price discovery.
ideas.evidence: Recent cost-pressure reporting and quarterly inflation data support the problem. They do not prove people will enter prices manually.
ideas.competitor: BazarBoard, Kombeshi, official DAM reports, phone calculators, paper lists and household chats. The proposed task uses the household’s own prices. Current habits remain the main competitor.
ideas.test: Ask 15 households or students to use it for two real shopping trips. At least 8 must choose to use it again.
ideas.risk: Do not label entered prices as live market data. Support piece, hali, kg and litre explicitly. Do not promise savings.
ideas.next: Add basket comparison only after users keep records. Use dated, attributable external prices only with a reliable data owner.

ideas.name: One useful local action
ideas.problem: A person wants to help but cannot easily judge which local action fits their time.
ideas.mvp: List five organizer-confirmed actions in one city. Show date, duration, conditions and official signup. Expire each listing automatically.
ideas.share: Create a simple invitation for friends. Report attendance only when the organizer confirms it.
ideas.difference: Help people find a first action across existing organizers. Let established groups manage volunteers.
ideas.evidence: Existing volunteer networks and a newly announced canal initiative show real activity. Demand for a separate discovery site is untested.
ideas.competitor: Organizer pages and existing volunteer networks. Partnership is more useful than another volunteer database.
ideas.test: Interview three organizers. Pilot with two willing partners. Confirm at least 10 attendances before expanding.
ideas.risk: A short event can need more than one hour. Show the real duration. Do not collect donations, publish volunteer contacts or certify unverified impact.
ideas.next: Expand only when an editor and organizer can keep dates, eligibility and cancellation notices current.

ideas.name: My application checklist
ideas.problem: An applicant needs to keep official links, documents and deadlines in one place.
ideas.mvp: A private checklist with user-entered deadlines, official links and calendar export. Keep the user’s application details on their device.
ideas.share: Export a blank checklist for a study group. Never include application IDs, fees paid or personal files by default.
ideas.difference: Personal task completion, not another job-circular feed or eligibility predictor.
ideas.evidence: September reporting describes intense demand for government posts. It does not measure missed deadlines or demand for a tracker.
ideas.competitor: Calendars, notes, spreadsheets and official application portals. Interviews must show a gap in those tools.
ideas.test: Recruit 15 applicants with real open applications. Observe whether they use the checklist during one deadline cycle.
ideas.risk: Wrong dates cause harm. Require a source link and a date check. Calendar export is not a guaranteed reminder service.
ideas.next: Add a curated notice feed only with a named editor and a correction process.

ideas.name: A family recipe card
ideas.problem: A family wants to preserve its own version of a dish in readable Bangla.
ideas.mvp: Enter ingredients, amounts, steps and a family note. Print or download the recipe. Keep the record private.
ideas.share: Send the card to a relative who wants to cook the dish. Attribute the cook only with their agreement.
ideas.difference: A private household record. স্মৃতির স্বাদ already documents Chakma food and memory as public cultural heritage.
ideas.evidence: Existing food-memory work supports cultural relevance. Direct demand for this recorder remains untested.
ideas.competitor: Recipe apps, notebooks and family chats. স্মৃতির স্বাদ documents Chakma food and memory publicly. The proposed difference is a private printable family record.
ideas.test: Ask 10 families to record one recipe with an older relative. Confirm that another person can use at least 7 cards.
ideas.risk: Avoid claims about health benefits or food safety. Do not declare one recipe the authentic version of a community.
ideas.next: Add audio only if families need it and contributors consent.

ideas.name: Choose a game for this group
ideas.problem: Friends or families need a quick way to choose an offline game.
ideas.mvp: Select group size, space and available equipment. Get one of eight reviewed games with simple rules and an invitation card.
ideas.share: A group shares one practical plan for its next meet-up.
ideas.difference: Help people arrange offline play. BrainKhela already offers online quizzes and games.
ideas.evidence: A 2026 traditional-games festival confirms participation in one setting. The website idea still needs observation.
ideas.competitor: Game explainers, online games and group chats. The useful gap is group setup and accessible rule cards.
ideas.test: Give five groups a card. At least three must arrange and complete a game without extra instructions.
ideas.risk: Rules vary by place. State the version. Include seated options. Avoid unsafe activities and unknown venue claims.
ideas.next: Extend the first memory-card tool only if users ask for a real group activity.

ideas.name: A verified fare card
ideas.problem: A commuter wants clear evidence for a specific route fare.
ideas.mvp: Five verified routes with vehicle class, approved fare, effective date and source. Download a readable reference card.
ideas.share: Send a useful route card to another commuter.
ideas.difference: Explain a checked route. Do not reduce the problem to a distance × rate formula.
ideas.evidence: September fare changes and reported fare disputes create a timely need. Exact route schedules still need primary verification.
ideas.competitor: Jaatra already advertises Dhaka bus journeys, transfers and fares. Official schedules remain the authority. A route-specific card needs a clear accuracy advantage.
ideas.test: Validate all five routes against current primary schedules. Interview 10 regular commuters about actual use.
ideas.risk: Wrong fares can provoke conflict. Route, vehicle, minimum fare and other adjustments matter. Do not launch from a press summary.
ideas.next: Proceed only when someone owns updates after each fare change.

ideas.name: A practical free afternoon
ideas.problem: A person wants a local activity with clear costs and practical details.
ideas.mvp: Ten checked options in one city with entry cost, travel notes, times and source. Export a small outing plan.
ideas.share: Invite a friend using a specific plan instead of a vague event link.
ideas.difference: Only pursue a verified affordability gap. nearU already offers event and experience discovery.
ideas.evidence: Existing services show supply. They do not prove an unmet need for another directory.
ideas.competitor: nearU, ticket sites and local event pages. A general directory is not a strong first project.
ideas.test: Ask 10 users to compare our shortlist with nearU. Continue only if the cost details change their decision.
ideas.risk: Free entry does not mean a free trip. Remove expired events. Avoid unsupported safety or accessibility claims.
ideas.next: Choose a specific audience and locality before writing a larger catalogue.

trends.method: Manual transcription of the rendered accessible chart table. Not an official CSV export. Bangladesh / Past 12 months / All categories / Web Search / search terms, not Topics. Last week incomplete.
trends.averageNote: Google-displayed averages, not arithmetic means calculated from the rounded transcribed rows. The moving original URL will show a different window at a later date.
trends.verification: All 53 displayed rows and averages checked against the rendered Chrome accessibility table. The saved CSV remains a manual transcription, not a Google CSV export.

limits: No directly inspected Facebook post/comment corpus.
No representative survey or psychological profiling.
Google Trends English terms are a deliberately small, biased comparison.

dailyTrends.selection: Six selected examples from the first 25 of 88 displayed rows. Not a top-six ranking.
dailyTrends.limits: Buckets are not exact search counts or unique people. Query clusters can overlap. Do not sum the values.
dailyTrends.recheckNote: The six selected buckets matched a later public-web check. The changing feed then showed 89 rows.

planningNote: All idea scores, priority labels, build durations and pilot thresholds are proposals and judgments, not measured demand, benchmarks or success probabilities.
